issues: React hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> injected inside <option> by the visual-editor dev overlay causes 'span cannot be a child of option' console error. Pre-existing dev-only artifact (visual editor injects x-source-var spans into every dynamic child, including <option>); does not affect functionality — the <select> still renders correct visa labels and value/onChange works. Consider suppressing overlay injection on <option> children or filtering it out in production build.

critical_code_review_comments: email_service.py:72 falls back to onboarding@resend.dev if SENDER_EMAIL is missing — with domain now verified, consider REQUIRING SENDER_EMAIL and failing fast at startup instead of silently falling back to the sandbox sender (would prevent regressions if env is misconfigured).

index.html is clean of Emergent branding, but the noscript block is still bare 'You need to enable JavaScript to run this app.' — consider a Ghana-visa-branded fallback message for SEO/no-JS crawlers.

favicon.png is 868KB — large for a favicon. Consider a size-optimised 32x32 / 192x192 pair (PNG or WebP) referenced separately, plus keep the current PNG only as apple-touch-icon. Not blocking but improves mobile performance and Lighthouse score.

Apply.jsx still triggers a React hydration console warning at every mobile page load due to visual-editor overlay injecting <span> inside <option>. Pre-existing (not iteration-8 regression). Cleanest fix: strip x-source-var injection for children of <option> in the visual editor, OR wrap option children in a String() to avoid the extra element.
server.py still 1000+ lines — iteration-5/6/7 recommendation to split into routers/ remains valid but out of scope for iteration 8.
